§7.3.1 Clipped Text

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

text-clipped-text · text fidelity layout

✅ Normative

Text cut off at the page edge MUST be rendered as the characters actually visible. A clipped word MUST NOT be completed, and an ellipsis or marker that the page does not print MUST NOT be appended to it.

A page whose content runs past the printable edge: the last letters of a label, the end of a sentence, the right-hand column of a table are simply absent. Nothing is overprinted or redacted; the ink was never there.

Research and developmen        49,294     ← the final t is off the page
Selling, general, and administrative     41,515
Note: … These measures ar
not in compliance with … different from po
forma measures …

Requirements

  • The visible fragment MUST be kept, verbatim — see Cell Text Fidelity§9.6.3. Dropping it loses printed content; completing it adds content that is not printed. See Never Drop, Never Invent§2.2.
  • The clipping itself MUST NOT be marked inside the text. A producer MAY record that a page is clipped outside the Markdown.
  • A clipped line inside a paragraph is joined to the next line like any other wrapped line; the fragment stays as printed.

✅ Sample — a statement cut at the right margin

Research and developmen in the stub, measures ar and from po in the note: the stub label and the note lines that reach the right edge lose their last characters.

Expected Markdown · excerpt
…
Cost of sales 59,130 63,865 65,189 263,067 304,213
Research and developmen 49,294 39,703 48,449 182,766 170,869
Selling, general, and administrative 41,515 47,806 41,153 168,484 215,318
Total costs and expenses 149,939 151,374 154,791 614,317 690,400
…

Note: The company provides pro forma financial data as an alternative for understanding its operating results. These measures ar not in compliance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America, and may be different from po forma measures used by other companies
